transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… mostly work stuff. I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s gotten pretty backed up, and my job sent me here… before it costs me a chance to move up.
Can you tell me more about these memory issues? For example, do you find yourself forgetting how to do tasks at work, or have trouble remembering things you used to know well?

Not really forgetting how to do the work, no. It’s more… I don’t remember the callbacks or work orders I’m supposed to get back to, or little follow-ups I told people I’d handle. Then they pile up, and now it’s enough that work sent me in before it messes up my chance to move up.
Do you find it hard to remember to do things you planned to do later, like calling someone back or completing a task you promised to finish?

Yeah. That’s pretty much the main thing. I’ll tell someone I’ll call back or finish a work order, and then… it just doesn’t happen unless somebody reminds me. It’s piled up enough that work sent me here before it costs me a promotion.
Do you also have trouble remembering to do things you planned to do outside of work, like personal errands, calls to friends or family, or other tasks around the house?
Mostly it’s the work stuff I’m aware of. The callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I said I’d do… that’s what’s really piled up and why they sent me here. I don’t really have much else to add.
Do you have trouble starting tasks or seeing them through to completion, even if you remember them?

Yeah… sometimes I’ll start the maintenance job and get the actual repair done, but then I don’t finish the last little parts. Like closing out the ticket, labeling the panel, or checking back with the tenant. Those are the things I leave hanging.
Do you find it hard to organize your tasks or plan out what needs to be done, especially at work?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get through the job part most of the time. I don’t know if it’s organizing exactly… I just know some things don’t get wrapped up right.
Outside of work, do you ever forget to do things you meant to do later, like running errands, calling someone back, or completing a chore you had planned?

I don’t know about outside work so much. What’s really been happening is I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, and basic follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s piled up enough that work sent me here… before I mess up my chance to move up.
Do you ever forget things you meant to do later in your personal life, like chores, errands, or plans with friends or family?
Mostly it’s the work stuff. Like… scheduled callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I said I’d do. That’s what’s gotten bad enough that they sent me here, before I lose my chance at moving up.

I mean… I’ve already said it’s mostly work. The scheduled callbacks, work orders, basic follow-ups I told people I’d handle. That’s what’s gotten bad enough that they sent me here, before I lose my shot at moving up.

Like I said, it’s more the work side of things. I keep missing scheduled callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d do… and it’s gotten bad enough they sent me here before I lose my shot at moving up.

I… I don’t know about personal stuff as much. What got me sent here is work — forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, even basic follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s piled up enough that they’re worried I’ll lose my chance to move up.
Have you ever forgotten to do things you meant to do later in your personal life, like chores, errands, or plans with friends or family?

I guess… I keep going back to work because that’s what’s really been showing up. Scheduled callbacks, work orders, basic follow-ups I said I’d handle — I forget them, and it’s piled up enough that they sent me here before I mess up my chance to move up.
Have you ever had a head injury or been exposed to any toxins or substances that might affect your memory or ability to complete tasks?
Not that I know of. I mean… I haven’t had some big head injury or anything like that, and I don’t know about toxins. Nothing comes to mind.
Have you ever had any episodes of confusion, significant memory loss, or difficulty thinking clearly before this job-related issue came up?
I don’t… I don’t think so. Not anything like confusion or big memory loss before this. At least nothing that stands out to me.
Have you ever forgotten to do things you meant to do later in your personal life, like chores, errands, or plans with friends or family?

Like I said, it’s mostly been the work stuff that’s obvious. I forget scheduled callbacks, work orders, little follow-ups I told people I’d do… and it’s gotten bad enough they sent me here before it costs me moving up.

I guess… yeah, maybe some. But the main thing is really what I said with work — forgetting callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s kind of piled up, and that’s why they sent me here.
Have you noticed any similar issues with forgetting or not following through on personal tasks or responsibilities, even before these work-related problems started?

I mean… I know I keep saying it, but the main thing I can point to is work. I’m forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, even basic follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s piled up enough that they sent me here before I lose my chance at moving up.
Have you had trouble remembering to complete tasks or follow through on things in your personal life before these work-related issues started?

I’m not sure how much before work, honestly. The thing I can really say is what brought me in: I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, and basic follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s piled up enough that they sent me here… before I lose my chance at moving up.
Before these work-related issues started, did you ever have trouble remembering to complete tasks or follow through on things in your personal life?

Yeah… I guess it goes back pretty far. Even in grade school, teachers would say I was bright, but I’d lose papers, miss parts of directions, or need reminders to finish my classwork. I don’t really like thinking about it, but… yeah, it was there before work.
